prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept / image edit. The current portrait is identity-authoritative. The already adopted knight and healer portraits are drawing-style references only. Optimize the supplied character as one coherent member of that same illustrated game roster.

Preserve species, gender, character identity, main color scheme, distinctive equipment, pose direction and full silhouette. Keep weapons, wings, tails and feet fully inside the portrait. Preserve the specific previous costume and gesture choices; do not transfer clothing, ornaments, species or poses from the references.

Rendering: refined 2D Japanese anime game illustration with controlled volume and clean cel-shaded forms. Clearly visible dark slightly thicker outer contours, medium structural overlap lines, fine sparse interior lines. Smooth intentional taper. Strong silhouette definition like the adopted references, without a uniform sticker stroke. Keep depth, appealing nuanced anime faces and a few meaningful material highlights; do not flatten into a generic cartoon or make a photorealistic / 3D render.

Humanoid anatomy: balanced adult proportions, natural head-to-shoulder and torso-to-leg relationship, readable hands, grounded stance; no tiny head, elongated thighs, pinched pelvis or distorted joints. Adult men have clean appealing East Asian anime features appropriate to their age and role, neither oily western realism nor effeminate identical faces. Nonhuman creatures remain nonhuman; machinery remains machinery.

Hair: organized large masses and a small number of clear locks, tidy silhouette, only a few purposeful loose strands. Cloth: broad continuous matte color areas, a few folds where tension, joints and gravity require them; no patchwork shadow blocks or dozens of decorative creases. White cloth stays white with restrained soft shadows. Armor: physically coherent plates, clear joins and limited grouped highlights; retain necessary signature ornament, remove invented gratuitous metal flourishes, micro-engraving, sparkling bits and layered filigree. Do not convert cloth into metal. Creature surfaces and mechanical parts follow the same line hierarchy and coherent restrained shading while keeping required anatomy and functional structure.

Background: opaque low-saturation softly graded color field matched to the character palette. Mid-dark overall, gently lighter behind the head and upper body, deeper near edges and lower corners, restrained foot contact shadow. Choose a subtle gray undertone that separates character colors: slate blue-gray, smoky gray-violet, muted sage-gray or warm charcoal/taupe. Uniform collection treatment, quiet broad forms. No scenery, architecture, foliage, clouds, smoke, particles, symbolic backdrop, magic circles, text, watermark, border, bokeh, grain, noise or photographic lighting. Existing character-specific weapon energy may remain, but no added environment effects or new rim lighting.

Portrait composition 2:3, target 1024x1536. One character only. Retain enough breathing room around signature silhouette and weapons. The supplied unit is the content; references provide only drawing quality and background treatment.

Input images: Image 1 edit target and identity authority. Image 2 adopted knight style reference only. Optimize the drawing across the entire subject, not merely its background. Essential line treatment: decisive near-black tapered silhouette contour about 3–5px at1024 width; medium lines at overlapping joints and plates, fine sparse interior seams. Preserve this short heavy teal armored reptile-cyborg/mechanical beast: dinosaur muzzle integrated with large forward-facing cannon, orange-red eye, silver muzzle guard with orange-gold conical spikes, huge segmented teal left fist, stocky two legs and black talons, short curled tail, large black rectangular back power-box with cyan emblem and red circular port, thick red conduits and horizontal secondary barrel. Mechanical assemblies stay functional and mechanical; no human face, hands or knight clothing. Preserve original stance facing viewer right and existing topology, cannon openings and all equipment. Redraw surfaces as larger coherent 2D cel-shaded shell/metal planes with subdued broad highlights; eliminate scattered chipped white sparkles and busy faceted shadow mosaics. Keep necessary original wear only sparingly at edges, retain current major panel divisions. Background softly graded low-saturation smoky gray-violet, mid-dark, lighter upper center and dark sides. Every box corner, barrel tip, tail, foot and fist within full 2:3 portrait.

Finishing pass:
Use case: style-transfer finishing edit. Image1 teal reptile tank-cyborg is exact mechanical design, pose, equipment and color authority. Image2 adopted knight is refined drawing style and dark-contour reference only. This is a mechanical nonhuman armored unit, keep the existing huge fist, head cannon, orange conical spikes, red eye, red hoses, cyan armored plates, gray muzzle guards, large black rectangular backpack with cyan emblem/red circular port, secondary right horizontal barrel, short tail and both clawed feet unchanged in topology.
The required main improvement is cleaner materials and stronger silhouette: substantially darken and strengthen tapered external contour to near-black3–4px at1024width; medium lines around actual mechanical joints and overlapping plates, fine sparse panel seams. Avoid uniform stickerstroke. Redraw cyan and gray armor surface shading into larger coherent planes, using one broad restrained highlight and shadow per actual metal plate. Remove disconnected chipped/reflection patches, pale speckles and faceted jagged shadow mosaics. The big fist's existing armored segments remain separate functional segments but each segment is a smooth readable broad plane; no many tiny subdivisions or new parts. Keep bolts/openings/seams necessary for mechanics, simplify extraneous small scratches. Gray cannon muzzle armor looks satin metal, not a pile of mirrored fragments. Backpack has broad black planes with clear edge bevels, same original cyan motif. Red conduits remain distinct continuous hoses. Preserve volume, material separation and original costume-free machinery in refined2D anime game illustration, not photoreal/3D.
Same smoky gray-violet soft graded background and contact shadow. Every backpack corner, barrel tip, spike, fist, tail and toe inside2:3portrait with breathing margin. No additions or human face.
visual_notes: Mechanical reptile tank retains segmented fist, gray head-cannon, gold spikes, red eye and conduits, black power-box/cyan motif/red port, secondary barrel, short tail and both clawed feet.
Finishing pass significantly cleans cyan/gray armor into broad coherent metal planes, reduces tiny scratches/reflection chips, and strengthens tapered dark silhouette.
Actual joint/panel topology preserved; no invented parts. Gray-violet soft gradient and full equipment framing retained.
